Atlanta Hawks.name: Asa Newell
Atlanta Hawks.note: Newell won't return to Wednesday's game against the Wizards due to a left great toe hyperextension, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports. He'll finish with two points (1-1 FG), three rebounds and three assists across 10 minutes.

Atlanta Hawks.name: Jalen Johnson
Atlanta Hawks.note: Johnson (ankle) is listed as out for Wednesday's game in Washington.

Atlanta Hawks.name: Jock Landale
Atlanta Hawks.note: Landale is out for Wednesday's game against the Wizards with a left hip strain, Kevin Chouinard of the Hawks' official site reports.

Atlanta Hawks.name: Mouhamed Gueye
Atlanta Hawks.note: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

Atlanta Hawks.name: Henri Veesaar
Atlanta Hawks.note: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

Boston Celtics.name: Devin Carter
Boston Celtics.note: Carter (illness) practiced with the G League's Maine Celtics on Wednesday.

Boston Celtics.name: Jayson Tatum
Boston Celtics.note: Tatum will be rested Wednesday against the Bucks, Jack Simone of BostonSportsJournal.com reports.

Brooklyn Nets.name: Egor Demin
Brooklyn Nets.note: The Nets exercised Demin's third-year team option for the 2027-28 season, Sharif Phillips-Keaton of USA Today reports Thursday.

Brooklyn Nets.name: Tyler Bilodeau
Brooklyn Nets.note: Bilodeau (shoulder) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Indiana.

Charlotte Hornets.name: Kon Knueppel
Charlotte Hornets.note: Knueppel (hamstring) exited to the locker room in the first quarter of Wednesday's game against the Nets, Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.

Charlotte Hornets.name: Grant Williams
Charlotte Hornets.note: The Hornets recalled Williams (hamstring) from the G League's Greensboro Swarm on Wednesday.

Chicago Bulls.name: Jalen Smith
Chicago Bulls.note: Smith (hand) won't return to Wednesday's game against the Knicks.

Chicago Bulls.name: Nic Claxton
Chicago Bulls.note: Claxton (hamstring) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against New York.

Cleveland Cavaliers.name: Jaylon Tyson
Cleveland Cavaliers.note: According to Cavaliers head coach Kenny Atkinson, Tyson (ankle) has been "on the court lately progressing well," Chris Fedor of The Cleveland Plain Dealer reports.

Cleveland Cavaliers.name: Peyton Watson
Cleveland Cavaliers.note: Watson (hamstring) is out for Wednesday's game in Oklahoma City.

Dallas Mavericks.name: Santi Aldama
Dallas Mavericks.note: Aldama (knee) is out for Wednesday's game against the Spurs, Grant Afseth of DallasHoopsJournal.com reports.

Dallas Mavericks.name: Max Christie
Dallas Mavericks.note: Christie (hip) is out for Wednesday's game against the Spurs.

Dallas Mavericks.name: Tarik Biberovic
Dallas Mavericks.note: Biberovic (heel) is listed as out for Monday's game against Sacramento.

Dallas Mavericks.name: Dereck Lively II
Dallas Mavericks.note: Lively (foot) is listed as out for Monday's game against the Kings.

Dallas Mavericks.name: Sergio de Larrea
Dallas Mavericks.note: Head coach Dusty May said Friday that de Larrea (knee) will be re-evaluated next week, Noah Weber of TheSmokingCuban.com reports.

Denver Nuggets.name: Spencer Jones
Denver Nuggets.note: Jones (hamstring) is out for Wednesday's game against the Raptors.

Denver Nuggets.name: Julian Strawther
Denver Nuggets.note: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

Detroit Pistons.name: Isaiah Joe
Detroit Pistons.note: Joe (hip) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Philadelphia.

Detroit Pistons.name: Jalen Duren
Detroit Pistons.note: Duren will be re-evaluated in two weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

Golden State Warriors.name: Gui Santos
Golden State Warriors.note: Santos (knee) has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Heat.

Golden State Warriors.name: Kristaps Porzingis
Golden State Warriors.note: The Warriors have stopped issuing salary payments to Porzingis, who remains away from the team and is considering retirement, Anthony Slater and Shams Charania of ESPN reported Wednesday.

Golden State Warriors.name: Moses Moody
Golden State Warriors.note: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

Golden State Warriors.name: Jimmy Butler III
Golden State Warriors.note: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

Houston Rockets.name: Steven Adams
Houston Rockets.note: Head coach Ime Udoka said Wednesday that Adams (calf) is still without a timetable to return and will be evaluated on a "weekly basis," Varun Shankar of the Houston Chronicle reports.

Houston Rockets.name: Clint Capela
Houston Rockets.note: Capela (ankle) is out for Wednesday's game against the Timberwolves.

Indiana Pacers.name: Kelly Oubre Jr.
Indiana Pacers.note: Oubre (calf) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Grizzlies.

Indiana Pacers.name: T.J. McConnell
Indiana Pacers.note: McConnell (hamstring) is out for Monday's game against the Hawks and remains week-to-week.

Indiana Pacers.name: Johnny Furphy
Indiana Pacers.note: Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.

Indiana Pacers.name: Ben Sheppard
Indiana Pacers.note: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

Indiana Pacers.name: Tyrese Haliburton
Indiana Pacers.note: Haliburton (hamstring) will miss at least the next two weeks of action, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

Los Angeles Clippers.name: Isaiah Jackson
Los Angeles Clippers.note: Jackson is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Heat with left groin soreness, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

Los Angeles Clippers.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
Los Angeles Clippers.note: The Clippers recalled Niederhauser (foot) from the G League's San Diego Clippers on Sunday.

Los Angeles Clippers.name: Brandon Ingram
Los Angeles Clippers.note: The Clippers recalled Ingram (Achilles) from the G League's San Diego Clippers on Sunday.

Los Angeles Clippers.name: Bradley Beal
Los Angeles Clippers.note: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

Los Angeles Clippers.name: Jordan Miller
Los Angeles Clippers.note: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

Los Angeles Lakers.name: Adou Thiero
Los Angeles Lakers.note: The Lakers assigned Thiero (knee) to the G League's Coachella Valley Lakers on Wednesday, per Khobi Price of The California Post.

Memphis Grizzlies.name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
Memphis Grizzlies.note: Pippen (back) won't play Wednesday against the Pacers.

Miami Heat.name: Giannis Antetokounmpo
Miami Heat.note: Antetokounmpo is probable to play Wednesday against the Clippers due to a sprained right wrist.

Milwaukee Bucks.name: Kam Jones
Milwaukee Bucks.note: Jones (ankle) won't play Wednesday in Boston.

Minnesota Timberwolves.name: Terrence Shannon Jr.
Minnesota Timberwolves.note: Shannon (hip) is out for Wednesday against the Rockets.

Minnesota Timberwolves.name: Anthony Edwards
Minnesota Timberwolves.note: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

Minnesota Timberwolves.name: Donte DiVincenzo
Minnesota Timberwolves.note: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

New Orleans Pelicans.name: Trey Murphy III
New Orleans Pelicans.note: Murphy (knees) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against Utah.

New Orleans Pelicans.name: Yves Missi
New Orleans Pelicans.note: Missi (knee) won't play in Saturday's game against Atlanta.

New York Knicks.name: Josh Hart
New York Knicks.note: Hart is out for Wednesday's game against the Bulls due to right ankle soreness.

Oklahoma City Thunder.name: Jaylin Williams
Oklahoma City Thunder.note: Williams (back) is listed as out for Wednesday's game versus Cleveland, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

Oklahoma City Thunder.name: Nikola Topic
Oklahoma City Thunder.note: Topic (back) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against Cleveland.

Oklahoma City Thunder.name: Thomas Sorber
Oklahoma City Thunder.note: Sorber (knee) is out for Wednesday's game against the Cavaliers.

Oklahoma City Thunder.name: Cason Wallace
Oklahoma City Thunder.note: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

Oklahoma City Thunder.name: Chet Holmgren
Oklahoma City Thunder.note: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

Oklahoma City Thunder.name: Jalen Williams
Oklahoma City Thunder.note: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMahon of ESPN.com reports.

Orlando Magic.name: Jonathan Isaac
Orlando Magic.note: Orlando recalled Isaac (knee) from the G League's Osceola Magic on Sunday.

Orlando Magic.name: Jalen Suggs
Orlando Magic.note: Suggs has been diagnosed with a mild bone bruise in his right knee and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

Orlando Magic.name: Paolo Banchero
Orlando Magic.note: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

Orlando Magic.name: Noah Penda
Orlando Magic.note: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

Orlando Magic.name: Izaiyah Nelson
Orlando Magic.note: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

Philadelphia 76ers.name: Dominick Barlow
Philadelphia 76ers.note: Head coach Nick Nurse said Wednesday that Barlow (back) likely needs another 10-12 days before he's cleared to return to the court, Derek Bodner of AllPHLY.com reports.

Philadelphia 76ers.name: Ariel Hukporti
Philadelphia 76ers.note: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

Phoenix Suns.name: Jordan Goodwin
Phoenix Suns.note: Goodwin (calf) won't play in Wednesday's game against Portland.

Phoenix Suns.name: Rasheer Fleming
Phoenix Suns.note: Fleming is out for Wednesday's game against the Trail Blazers due to a sprained left ankle.

Phoenix Suns.name: Mark Williams
Phoenix Suns.note: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

Portland Trail Blazers.name: Ja Morant
Portland Trail Blazers.note: Morant has been diagnosed with a Grade 2 left hamstring strain and is expected to miss four weeks, Portland announced Friday.

Portland Trail Blazers.name: Shaedon Sharpe
Portland Trail Blazers.note: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

Sacramento Kings.name: Daeqwon Plowden
Sacramento Kings.note: Plowden (illness) is out for Wednesday's game against the Lakers.

Sacramento Kings.name: Maxime Raynaud
Sacramento Kings.note: Raynaud (knee) is progressing in his rehabilitation and will be re-evaluated in approximately two weeks, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

Sacramento Kings.name: Keegan Murray
Sacramento Kings.note: Murray (ankle) will be re-evaluated in 10-to-14 days, NBA reporter Marc Stein reports.

Sacramento Kings.name: Ben Simmons
Sacramento Kings.note: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

San Antonio Spurs.name: Tobias Harris
San Antonio Spurs.note: Harris (calf) is listed as out for Saturday's game against Minnesota.

San Antonio Spurs.name: Jayden Quaintance
San Antonio Spurs.note: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

Toronto Raptors.name: Kawhi Leonard
Toronto Raptors.note: Leonard has completed treatment to reduce swelling in his left knee and he will be re-evaluated in one week, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

Toronto Raptors.name: Nate Bittle
Toronto Raptors.note: Bittle (foot) is out for Monday's game against the Clippers and remains without a timetable to return.

Utah Jazz.name: Jusuf Nurkic
Utah Jazz.note: Nurkic (foot) is out for Wednesday's game against the Pelicans.

Utah Jazz.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
Utah Jazz.note: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

Utah Jazz.name: Trey Alexander
Utah Jazz.note: Alexander won't play Wednesday against the Grizzlies due to a left knee bone bruise.

Washington Wizards.name: Reece Beekman
Washington Wizards.note: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.

Washington Wizards.name: Tristan Vukcevic
Washington Wizards.note: Vukcevic (hip) is listed as out for Monday's game against Orlando.

Washington Wizards.name: Justin Champagnie
Washington Wizards.note: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

Washington Wizards.name: Jamir Watkins
Washington Wizards.note: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
